links.outcome: Hallucination and documentation quality of AI scribe vs human notes (modified PDQI-9)
links.effect: Significant differences in accuracy (P=0.022), thoroughness (P<0.001), succinctness (P<0.001) and freedom from hallucination (P=0.025); overall PDQI-9 difference not significant (P=0.071). Both AI and human notes contained hallucinations.
links.quote: The finding that both AI and human documentation contain 'hallucinations' challenges the assumption that human‑generated documentation represents the gold standard of clinical documentation quality.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of AI scribes versus human clinicians in simulated GP consultations, measuring documentation quality and hallucinations without testing a specific organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
